notes.zh-CN: 手机端新增图片全屏查看：对话里你发过的照片和回复中出现的图片都能点开预览，支持放大缩小、原始尺寸、适应屏幕、双击和双指捏合；从手机发出的照片会在会话里保留缩略图，撤下的照片会自动关闭预览。桌面端右键菜单的「粘贴」改为调用 WebView 原生粘贴，截图和图片也能直接进入输入框，效果与键盘 Cmd+V 一致。侧栏项目标题新增一键收起按钮，展开的项目可立即收起会话列表。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: The mobile app now opens images full screen: photos you sent and pictures that appear in replies can be tapped to preview, with zoom in and out, actual size, fit to screen, double-tap and pinch. Photos sent from the phone keep a thumbnail in the conversation, and removing a staged photo closes its preview. The desktop context menu’s Paste now runs the WebView’s native paste, so screenshots and images land in the composer just like Cmd+V. Project headers in the sidebar gained a one-click collapse control. The universal macOS app has a development signature and is unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK has a debug signature. The iOS IPA has a development signature and installs on registered team devices.
